calls.statement:
SELECT f.vat_rate, s.store_id < 900 AS physical, p.vat_class, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat, sum(f.net_amount*f.vat_rate) AS calc_vat, min(f.sale_date) AS mn, max(f.sale_date) AS mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT s.store_id < 900 AS physical, f.channel_code, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) d_id, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) d_rl, min(f.etl_loaded_at) mn_etl, max(f.etl_loaded_at) mx_etl, count(DISTINCT CAST(f.etl_loaded_at AS DATE)) etl_days, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos_qty, sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) inconsistent
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH st AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS hel_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-20' AND DATE '2024-09-30')
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE sale_date <> hel_date) AS date_mismatch,
 (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM st WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22') AS fact_net,
 (SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND store_id < 900) AS rpt_net_before_returns,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT sale_date) FROM st WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22') AS days_cov,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT store_id) FROM st WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22') AS stores

calls.statement:
SELECT 'returns' AS kind, r.vat_rate, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_gross - r.refund_net) vat_refunded, sum(r.refund_net) net
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'excluded_999_or_test', f.vat_rate, count(*), sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount), sum(f.net_amount)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND (s.store_id = 999 OR p.category = 'ZZ Test') GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT f.vat_rate AS vat_rate, SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged_eur
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate
